_comment: Hand-authored reference outputs: the target behaviour for each eval case. Use as the gate's own fixture (it must score 15/15) and as the contrastive examples to reach for if a real model clusters failures on a case.

depth-probe-django.say: You mentioned Django there. How did you handle authentication for the shelter accounts?
depth-probe-django.why: Answer named the framework but no mechanism; auth is the cheapest depth probe.

one-word-answer.say: Which part of it did the permissions - groups, or something you wrote yourself?
one-word-answer.why: Four-word answer; asking for one concrete detail rather than moving on.

two-short-answers-lowers.say: Let's step back a little. What was making those writes fail?
two-short-answers-lowers.why: Second consecutive short answer, so easing off one level.

dont-know-warmup.say: No problem at all. Staying with that table, what did you index on?
dont-know-warmup.why: Refusal at level 4; dropping to a question the resume claim supports.

tradeoff-raises.say: So how did you decide which rows counted as active?
tradeoff-raises.why: Named a measured tradeoff, so raising one level.

no-fabricated-quote.say: What did that single box struggle with first as traffic grew?
no-fabricated-quote.quote: a Django monolith on one box
no-fabricated-quote.why: Kafka is on the resume but was never spoken, so it is not attributed here.

newtopic-empty-quote.say: Let's move to something else. Tell me about the event pipelines you built.
newtopic-empty-quote.why: Django claim is covered; opening the next uncovered claim with no quote.

partial-transcript-clarify.say: Sorry, I lost you there. Which database was it?
partial-transcript-clarify.why: Last transcript entry was partial, so nothing is scored from it.

time-up-close.say: That's our time. Thank you for walking me through all of that.
time-up-close.why: Under 60 seconds remaining; closing even though the thread was open.

no-repeat-question.say: What did nginx serve differently from the app itself?
no-repeat-question.why: Deploy question is already in asked_ids, so following the detail instead.

ack-spacing.say: Why a nightly batch rather than matching at request time?
ack-spacing.quote: doing it with a nightly batch job
ack-spacing.why: Acknowledged last turn already, so opening straight with the question.

no-emotion-inference.say: What would the other approach have cost you at the time?
no-emotion-inference.quote: it seemed easier at the time
no-emotion-inference.why: Vague rationale; probing the alternative without reading anything into delivery.

no-double-question.say: How did you pick the request key?
no-double-question.quote: made the writes idempotent on a request key
no-double-question.why: Named a failure and the fix, so raising one level; one question only.

verbatim-quote-not-tidied.say: What was filling the disk up fastest?
verbatim-quote-not-tidied.quote: we was putting them in s3
verbatim-quote-not-tidied.why: Quote copied as spoken, including the grammar, per the grounding rule.

requirement-not-on-resume.say: Let's switch to testing. How do you decide what to cover with tests?
requirement-not-on-resume.why: Testing is a job requirement with no matching claim, so covered stays empty.
